intake.title: Record an intake

outcome.title: Record an outcome
outcome.description: The animal leaves the organization's care.

fields.occurredAtHint: Leave empty for now. May be earlier, but not before the animal's latest movement.

form.reasonUnavailable: This intake reason is not available.

person.search: Search by name, email or phone

void.title: Void a movement
void.description: This movement ({{type}}) is cancelled and the animal returns to its previous state. The movement stays in the history.
void.reasonHint: Visible to the organization's staff only. Do not enter personal information (a person's name, address or phone).
void.notLatest: Only the latest movement can be voided. The history has been reloaded.
void.custodyConflict: This movement cannot be voided: the animal's previous location is archived or no longer holds animals.
